products.note: 3D creation AI plugins; open-source; local processing; model provenance varies by plugin

profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation based around Blender, a free and open-source 3D creation software suite. The software covers a broad range of disciplines including 3D modeling, rendering, rigging, animation, camera and object tracking, visual effects, and 2D drawing in a 3D viewport. The foundation describes Blender as used in short films, advertisements, TV series, and feature films, and notes that VFX professionals have called its tracker "probably the best tracker in the market." Blender maintains a Python-controlled interface and a public API that supports a community of add-on developers. It is a member of ASWF, Khronos, Linux Foundation, and OIN, and the site cites hardware support from AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons, described as third-party plugins for 3D creation that run with local processing and are open-source, with model provenance varying by individual plugin. These add-ons form part of what the foundation describes as an ever-expanding ecosystem of tutorial makers, content creators, add-on developers, and global marketplaces. Blender 5.2 LTS, referenced on the site, introduces a Cycles Texture Cache intended to make rendering scenes with many image textures more memory efficient.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC disclosures are recorded in the held facts for Blender Foundation.
